summary: ON NOW Trivia backend + frontend fully tested. All 7 pytest cases pass (REST create/get/404, TV WS snapshot, player join broadcast to TV+phone, full classic game flow with private 'you' message, blitz T/F 2-option, buzzer flow with lockout). Playwright E2E: /trivia loads publicly (bypasses LoginGate), QR + 4-letter code + category/mode buttons visible, start-btn correctly disabled until phone joins; phone /trivia/play?room=CODE loads publicly, name input + Save&Join works, chip appears on TV, 5-question classic game runs end-to-end through countdown→question→reveal→leaderboard→podium with Play Again. Timings from spec matched (countdown 3s, reveal 5s, leaderboard 4s). Fallback question bank used when OpenTDB fails.

issues: Question text uses a very dim gray color while animating in (tri-rise); at large sizes on black background it can look almost unreadable for the first ~0.5s of the animation. Not blocking; consider stronger contrast or shorter animation.

critical_code_review_comments: trivia.py:490 — classic/blitz answer accepts any int index without validating range (0..len(options)-1). A malicious payload with idx=999 would still be stored as an incorrect answer (harmless but sloppy). Consider validating 0 <= idx < len(options).
trivia.py:411 role check: any role value other than 'tv' is treated as a player. Fine but undocumented; consider explicit check.

useTriviaSocket.js:52 — dep array [code, role, name] means every keystroke into the name field (before join) would tear down the socket. Currently mitigated because socket only opens after joined=true, but if name is changed post-join it will drop and reconnect the WS (retry loop). Consider using a ref for name after connection.
Room cleanup only runs opportunistically inside POST /rooms; long-idle rooms are pruned only when a new room is created. Acceptable for MVP.
No auth on TV socket — anyone with the 4-letter code (23^4 ≈ 280K combos) can act as TV host and start/reset the game. Party-game context, low risk.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_trivia.py (asyncio-mode=auto). Classic full-flow test runs ~40s (3 rounds). Blitz test asserts options=['True','False']. Buzzer test uses invalid answer=999 (ignored by server) then answer=0 to force either reveal-done or player-locked path. Frontend E2E in browser worked end-to-end via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Only cosmetic note: question text animation appears low-contrast briefly.
